title: Effects of Core Stabilization Approach on Patients With Upper Extremity Injuries
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the effects of the addition of core stabilization exercises to a traditional upper extremity rehabilitation program in upper extremity injuries.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Traumatic distal segment injuries (elbow and wrist)
* Patients in their subacute stage.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multiple joint problems
* Bilateral extremity problems
* Reflex sympathetic dystrophy
* Trunk and lower extremity problems
* Non-union fractures
* Malignant ans systemic diseases
